title: Finite generation and reduction kernels for an algebraic adic tower
statement: Let A be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], I an ideal, B its I-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and T an inverse system of A-modules [def-weil-inverse-system]. Index n denotes level n+1. Assume every T_n is finite [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], I^(n+1)T_n=0, and every successor transition T_(n+1) -> T_n is surjective with kernel I^(n+1)T_(n+1). Let N be a B-module and e: Res_A N -> lim T an A-linear isomorphism whose projections satisfy the completed scalar residue equation of [lem-weil-pbc-adic-tower-completed-scalar-limit]. Then N is finite over B. Each projection p_n=e followed by the nth limit projection is surjective, with kernel I^(n+1)N as an A-submodule.

proof.text: Obtain a surjection q from the completed finite free module using only finiteness of T_0. Mathlib AdicCompletion.piEquivFin identifies the source with B^d, and Module.Finite.of_surjective then proves finiteness of N.

Shift the natural-number tower to n+k. This shift is final, so its opposite preserves the limiting cone. Apply Mathlib Concrete.surjective_π_app_zero_of_surjective_map to get surjectivity of the nth projection, and compose with the isomorphism e.

For x in the nth projection kernel, choose y with q(y)=x and correct y by a global presentation-kernel vector z with the same nth free residue. Then y-z has zero nth evaluation. Since A is Noetherian, I is finitely generated; AdicCompletion.pow_smul_top_eq_ker_eval gives y-z in I^(n+1) times the completed free module. Restrict q to an explicit A-linear map and use Submodule.smul_top_le_comap_smul_top to map this membership to x in I^(n+1)N.

The reverse kernel inclusion follows from A-linearity of the projection and annihilation of T_n: every scalar in I^(n+1) kills every projected vector. Use Submodule.smul_le and Submodule.smul_mem_smul.

lean.statement:
theorem adicTower_finiteLimit (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (T : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} A)
    (hfinite : ∀ n : ℕ, Module.Finite A (T.obj (op n)))
    (hzero : ∀ n : ℕ, I ^ (n + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule A (T.obj (op n))) = ⊥)
    (htrans : ∀ n : ℕ,
      Function.Surjective (T.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) ∧
      LinearMap.ker (T.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op).hom =
        I ^ (n + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule A (T.obj (op (n + 1)))))
    (N : ModuleCat.{u} (AdicCompletion I A))
    (e : (restrictScalars (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion I A))).obj N ≅ limit T)
    (hscalar : ∀ (n : ℕ) (r : AdicCompletion I A) (a : A) (x : N),
      AdicCompletion.evalₐ I (n + 1) r = Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)) a →
      (e.hom ≫ limit.π T (op n)) (r • x) =
        a • (e.hom ≫ limit.π T (op n)) x) :
    Module.Finite (AdicCompletion I A) N ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ, Function.Surjective (e.hom ≫ limit.π T (op n)) ∧
      LinearMap.ker (e.hom ≫ limit.π T (op n)).hom =
        I ^ (n + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule A
          ((restrictScalars (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion I A))).obj N))
